root_cause.text: Recursive function __aa_profile_list_release() called during profile removal causes kernel stack exhaustion when handling deeply nested profiles.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "The profile removal code uses recursion when removing nested profiles, which can lead to kernel stack exhaustion and system crashes." The reproducer creates 1024 levels of nested profiles via apparmor_parser, then triggers removal via `/sys/kernel/security/apparmor/.remove`, confirming the recursion depth exceeds the stack limit. The patch replaces the recursive call with an iterative while loop that repeatedly finds and removes leaf profiles, eliminating the recursion.
